body:
**Mods that share files**
- Some authors make several mods with the same base files, such as character mods that bring one framework each. Until now, the second one could only replace the first.
- When a download has files of an installed mod, byte for byte the same, and both have files of their own, the install review now offers **Keep both, and share the files that are the same in both**. One copy serves both mods; it stays while one of them is on and goes with the last. Choose it only when the authors say the mods work together. Thanks to the player who reported it.
- **Update** stays the first choice. A choice that cannot work for the download is no longer shown, and **CHOICES EXPLAINED** above the list says what each choice is for.
- The command line tool has `--share-files` for the same.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.5.0.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.5.0.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
